scope: Independent future CPU visual-feature cache candidate; no frozen primary service/replay/source changed, no GPU/torch import/image decode/weight read performed by this branch

policy.storage: Pageable CPU FP16 tensors, synchronous explicit D2H/H2D for first conservative version; transfer costs stay in HTTP
policy.fairness: FP16 and AWQ same capacity/eviction/reset/transfer policy; off control same new entry but no RGB hashing or feature-copy cost
policy.cache_key: Actual decoded RGB bytes SHA, RGB size/mode, complete image_processor.to_dict configuration and effective resize args/mm kwargs, fixed processor code versions, native output grid_thw, complete verified checkpoint SHA and model/vision config identity, target dtype/backend/source identity
policy.identity_note: Full checkpoint SHA conservatively binds visual weights; no claim that the separately quantized full checkpoint shares a feature cache with FP16
preserved: original image order and repeated slots
main image embeddings plus all three DeepStack arrays

steps: Call collect_images before original preprocess; afterwards appended preprocess results lack type fields and cannot be traversed as original image content.

For actual decoded PIL image, use itself if modeRGB else native convertRGB semantics; hash actual RGB.tobytes once and release the bytes buffer. About 8MiB total at nine480x640 images, rather than63MiB FP32processed tensor.

Bind full image_processor.to_dict(), effective get_processor_args(mm_processor_kwargs), processor class/source versions. Native Qwen2VLImageProcessorFast path performs deterministic resize/rescale/normalize.
Call unchanged original preprocess; attach generated identity to each returned preprocessing dictionary, matching image order and actual output grid.

VisionModel.to_pytorch_aux retains additional preprocessing dictionary fields. Qwen2_5_VLInputProcessor (Qwen3 alias) wrapper copies identity into each result MultiModalTensor.meta after original preprocessing.
MultiModalTensor.to_device preserves non-tensor metadata dictionaries/strings; no GPU values are read to recover the key.
guard_requirements: actual pixel_values row count equals t*h*w
empty-image preprocess returns tuple and must bypass without expecting PreprocessInputResult

cache_forward_design.hook: Native Qwen3 prepare wrapper carries ordered image metadata as new private forward kwargs; native forward wrapper intercepts only self.visual.forward
cache_forward_design.miss_strategy: Count preexisting-cache hits separately from duplicate slots in current request. Encode all distinct missing images in one native visual batch, never one forward per missing image.
layout: Raw pixel patch slices, positional embedding slices and both rotary cos/sin slices use native grid raw lengths t*h*w.
Miss cu_seqlens is rebuilt as cumulative h*w lengths from selected CPU grids WITHOUT leading zero; visual.forward pads its own zero. Do not slice old cumulative offsets.
Each native result array is split at merged length t*h*w/merge_size^2. All four arrays are stored, never only primary embeddings.

Restore every original slot in original order, including duplicates; concatenate four complete arrays and return the original visual tuple structure. Native image mask, language and mRoPE stay untouched.
If every slot is unique and misses, call original full-batch visual with identical input objects, populate CPU entries and return the unchanged native full-batch output to avoid unnecessary assembly.
storage_safety: CPU entry owns four detached copies, not views into a larger GPU batch.
Blocking copy completion precedes insertion/read eviction; no speculative async pinned-memory lifetime or CUDA event protocol in initial version.
Model-instance cache state, single request/uni executor, no shared feature cache across processes or checkpoints.
RGB/processor hashing and all D2H/H2D costs remain inside the measured HTTP path.

cold_reset_contract.control: New cache_request_plan.json, SHA frozen before startup; independent new runner only. Existing frozen replay remains cache-off and unchanged.

expected prompt tokens and image count

cold_reset_contract.behavior: Initial cache empty; numeric warmups may populate cache for gate. Before first formal request, and each later episode start, clear actual LRU and write reset receipt bound to exact request index/episode/plan SHA with before/after occupancy and bytes. Episode clear must not be merely a client-side annotation.
cold_reset_contract.tail: Final flush records previous formal request receipts; tail excluded from metrics.
cold_reset_contract.receipt_timing: Buffer request stats after successful host model forward; flush previous stats at next prefill for both off and on controls, no per-hit tensor comparisons in real requests.

numeric_gate.allowed: Only explicitly excluded input warmup indices0/1 with saved plan phaseinput_warmup and existing native inputSHA receipt; unknown formal shapes never trigger double computation.
numeric_gate.reference: Original full-image native visual forward only, not whole language model.
numeric_gate.candidate: Actual cache assembly with unique miss batch and copies; optionally replay same warmup once as all-hit CPU roundtrip without a new visual encoder call.
numeric_gate.failure: Write failure receipt and stop. Do not silently relax tolerance or retain a speed claim. Any later tolerance candidate requires separate preregistration, all343 same-weight token comparison and subset20quality.
numeric_gate.limitation: Changing miss-batch size may change GEMM/Conv3d rounding. Mathematical image independence does not prove bitwise equality; gate may reject this candidate.
